entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: Mad scientist of Innistrad who created Ludevic's Abomination to feed on torch-wielding mobs.

entities.name: Ludevic's Abomination
entities.description: A large lizard horror that hatches from an egg, created by Ludevic.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
entities.description: Innistrad forest whose plants meld with werewolves to create Ulvenwald Captives.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane home to Falcon Abominations and Ludevic's Abomination.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Toxic Abominations appeared on Dominaria.

events.summary: Ludevic creates an abomination that hatches from an egg so it can feed on torch-wielding mobs that killed earlier creatures.
events.quote: He created it to be able to feed on torch-wielding mobs after some of his previous creatures died to them.

relations.quote: Ludevic of Ulm also created a type of abomination known as Ludevic's Abomination
